description: TRUECHART+ for Power BI delivers professional IBCS-compliant visualizations, responsive dashboard design with the Visual Editor, and interactive analysis through native pivot mode with drill-down hierarchies. A built-in default Notation Manual ensures consistent formatting across all reports and dashboards. Core visualization and analysis Design responsive dashboard layouts with the Visual Editor and perform interactive analysis using native pivot mode with drill-down hierarchies. Governed visualizations The default IBCS-compliant Notation Manual ensures consistent use of colours, text, and visual aids across all reports and dashboards. Inline data input and collaboration Basic input capabilities are available in the Microsoft Marketplace version. Light Planning and scenario management Light Planning with scenario creation, version control, and direct data entry in tables is available only with a paid TRUECHART license. Administration and security User and licence management, role-based access, and integration with identity providers (including Entra ID and LDAP) are available through the TRUECHART+ Management Console and require a paid TRUECHART license. Licensing All core functionality is available for free to try within Power BI Desktop.
